subject: general
question: Cristiano Ronaldo belongs to which country?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Portugal__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Cristiano Ronaldo is a professional footballer from Portugal.
 
• He has won five Ballon d'Or awards, which are given annually to the world's best male footballer.
 
• Ronaldo has played for clubs such as Sporting Lisbon, Manchester United, Real Madrid, and Juventus.
 
• He is known for his incredible goal-scoring records, athleticism, and leadership on the field.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Cristiano Ronaldo was born on February 5, 1985, in Funchal, Madeira, Portugal.
 
• Aside from his football career, Ronaldo is also known for his extensive charity work, including donations to children's hospitals, disaster relief efforts, and cancer research.
 
• He has become one of the most marketable and highest-paid athletes in the world, with numerous endorsement deals.
 
• Ronaldo has also ventured into business, owning a fashion boutique and a chain of CR7 hotels.
